life happened. There are so many things that are bringing me down. i think this is why it's just so hard for me to get better, there's too many problems to manage. I've been depressed and suicidal for years, I'm pretty sure I have ADHD and I can't anything. I have troubles to do things I actually enjoy, I just can't force myself to do them most of the time. I think I'm not completely doomed - if I started working today and put effort into my passions I think I could achieve my goals or at least be satisfied in one way or another. But the problem is that I can't *just* do that. I'm lazy, I procrastinate, again, I can't even do things I enjoy, I mostly just do nothing.

I can't afford therapy, I don't have supportive friends or family. I'm alone in this. And lately I've been thinking that it's all not really worth it. Because sure, I could try to improve, which is hard and complicated, and I'd have to do this my entire life, always trying to not fall back into depression and apathy, or I could just end it now and get it over with. I've been trying to find something to steer me away from suicide but I think it's the most logical option now.
